title: Analytics Dashboard
content: Build analytics dashboard page. Header: page title, date range picker, export button. Metrics row: key stat cards with values, trends, sparklines. Charts section: line chart (traffic over time), bar chart (top pages), pie chart (sources), geo map. Data tables: sortable tables for detailed data. Filters: segment by user type, device, location. Comparison: period over period.

variants.simple: Create analytics dashboard with charts, metrics, and date filters.
variants.detailed: Build analytics dashboard page. Header: page title, date range picker, export button. Metrics row: key stat cards with values, trends, sparklines. Charts section: line chart (traffic over time), bar chart (top pages), pie chart (sources), geo map. Data tables: sortable tables for detailed data. Filters: segment by user type, device, location. Comparison: period over period.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive analytics dashboard for data visualization. Page header: flex justify-between items-center, "Analytics" title, date range picker (preset options: Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Custom Range with calendar), comparison toggle ("Compare to previous period"), export dropdown (PDF, CSV, PNG). Quick filters bar: segment selectors (All Users, New Users, Returning), device filter, country/region filter, channel filter. Metrics overview: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Metric cards: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6, metric name (text-sm text-gray-500), value (text-3xl font-bold), trend badge (TrendingUp green or TrendingDown red with percentage), sparkline mini-chart (last 7 days trend), comparison text ("vs 12,345 prev period"). Key metrics: Total Visitors, Page Views, Bounce Rate, Avg Session Duration, Conversion Rate, Revenue. Primary chart section: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6. Chart header: title, granularity toggle (Hour, Day, Week, Month). Line chart: multi-series (current vs previous period, dashed for comparison), hover tooltips with values, responsive sizing. Chart library: Recharts, Chart.js, or Victory. Secondary charts grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Charts include: Top Pages (horizontal bar chart), Traffic Sources (pie/donut chart), Device Breakdown (pie chart), Geographic Distribution (map or top countries table), Browser/OS breakdown. Real-time section: if applicable, live visitor count, active pages, recent events stream. Data tables section: sortable, searchable tables. Pages table: Page URL, Views, Unique Views, Avg Time, Bounce Rate. Sources table: Source, Users, Sessions, Conversion Rate. Column sorting: click header to sort. Search/filter inputs. Pagination. Export table data. Drill-down: clicking chart elements filters dashboard or opens detail view. Goal tracking: progress toward set goals with progress bars. Alerts: notable changes highlighted (traffic spike, drop alert). Loading: skeleton charts and cards. Error states: per-widget error with retry. Mobile: stack all sections, scrollable charts, collapsible sections. Accessibility: charts have data tables as alternatives, colors distinguishable.
